newsitem.title: USA: PacTel, others appeal FCC rules.
newsitem.headline: PacTel, others appeal FCC rules.

text.p: Pacific Telesis Group said Friday it has asked a federal court to overturn U.S. Federal Communications Commission rules governing how competitors may connect to its network.
PacTel claimed the new rules would slow the advent of full telecommunications competition.

The appeal, filed with the U.S. Court of Appeals in Washington, D.C. with Bell Atlantic Corp and BellSouth Corp, claimed the FCC's August 8 rules overstepped the boundaries of the Telecommunications Act of 1996. The suit is not seeking a stay of the commission's rules.
PacTel said it believes the FCC rules would stifle competition by forcing California consumers to subsidize the entry of long-distance companies in the local market.
